newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle at $112/dressed, up $3 - trade.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle at $112/dressed, up $3 - trade.

text.p: Nebraska feedlot cattle sold briskly at $110.00 to mostly $112.00 per cwt on a dressed basis near midday Tuesday, with the top price up $3.00 from Monday, market sources said.
About 25,000 head sold, with volume for the day expected to be "significant", they said.
Sales early at $110.00 to $111.00 were quickly eclipsed when major packers raised bids to $112.00, sources said.
Cattle also sold at $68.00 to $69.00 per cwt on a live basis, although volume totals were not available. Gains were attributed to strong beef demand, they said.
